actors.name: Kang Bramblestaff
actors.greeting: A meal, a poultice and a careful test. We start with what we can do.

actors.name: Kor Bloodtusk
actors.greeting: Stay alert. The people at this camp have enough to fear already.

actors.name: Nala
actors.greeting: Give Leza privacy. I will tell you when your help is needed.

actors.name: Mei Barrelbottom
actors.greeting: We still have homes here. Some days it is harder to remember why we keep them.

actors.name: Dawnchaser Family Elder
actors.greeting: The little ones eat first. We can wait, but they should not have to.

actors.name: Displaced Caravan Traveler
actors.greeting: We lost the wagons on the road. I never thought a place to sit could mean so much.

actors.name: Wounded Expedition Scout
actors.greeting: Nala says I must rest. It is easier when I know someone is watching the road.

actors.name: Na Lek
actors.greeting: The raiders have bound these waters. Break their guardians before you draw a sample.

quests.title: Search Party
quests.objectives: Find Chezin at the ruined scouting camp and recover his report.
quests.description: Jarod trusts you, and that is enough for me. My brother-in-law Chezin went to the scouting camp southeast of us. The camp has fallen silent. Find his abandoned pack beside the ruined scouting shelter. If he has a report, bring it back. Do not promise Leza he is coming home until you know.
quests.completion: Chezin is gone. I will tell Leza myself. These orders give us something we can still act on.
quests.request_text: What happened to Chezin? Bring me the report he left behind.
quests.return_text: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco at the Dawnchaser field camp.

quests.title: Poisoned!
quests.objectives: Collect 5 poisoned blades from relic raiders and bring them to Dezco.
quests.description: Chezin's report describes the raiders' poisoned weapons. Kill relic raiders at their marsh camp and bring five blades back as samples. Nala needs to identify the poison before treating anyone. Clicking the medical tent does not provide that evidence.
quests.completion: The fever has eased, but this is not a cure. We will keep looking, and Nala will stay with her.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco at the Dawnchaser field camp.

quests.title: Skitterer Stew
quests.objectives: Gather 8 skitterer meat and help prepare food for the weakened camp.
quests.description: Gather eight pieces of skitterer meat from the pools around camp, then speak to Kang at the cooking hearth. He will prepare food for the weakened expedition.
quests.completion: Hot food will do more for this camp than another empty assurance. Thank you.
quests.request_text: Eight portions of meat, and a pot ready for the camp. Have you prepared them?
quests.return_text: Speak with Kang Bramblestaff at the Dawnchaser cooking hearth.

quests.title: Blind Them!
quests.objectives: Kill the relic raider outrider watching the expedition.
quests.description: An outrider scouts the track north of the Dawnchaser camp. Defeat him before he reports our position and brings more raiders down on the expedition.
quests.completion: Their lookout line is broken. Now we can prepare without their eyes on every movement.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Kor Bloodtusk at the Dawnchaser field camp.

quests.title: Threat from the Marsh Ruins
quests.objectives: Defeat 8 relic raiders before their next camp attack.
quests.description: The watchers were only the edge of the force. Defeat relic raiders and hexers at their dig, and bring back eight insignia as proof that their next attack has been broken. This expedition has families in it, and I mean to keep them alive.
quests.completion: They will have to regroup before they try us again. I will keep the watch.
quests.request_text: Bring eight raider insignia. I need to know the next attack has been broken.
quests.return_text: Speak with Kor Bloodtusk at the Dawnchaser field camp.

quests.title: Herbal Remedies
quests.objectives: Collect 12 marsh lotus leaves and help Kang prepare a second treatment.
quests.description: The antidote eased the fever, but Leza is still weak. Collect twelve marsh lotus leaves among the southern marsh paths. Ask Kang to prepare the treatment when you have them, then return the leaves to me. These are camp supplies, not a test of your herbalism.
quests.completion: Kang has prepared what he can from these leaves. We have bought time, not certainty.
quests.request_text: Have you gathered twelve leaves and helped Kang prepare the remedy?
quests.return_text: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco at the Dawnchaser field camp.

quests.title: The Relic Raiders' Agenda
quests.objectives: Kill the relic raider dominator and recover his excavation orders.
quests.description: The dominator leads the raiders at the marsh ruins. Defeat him and take his excavation orders. Those orders will tell us why the raiders have come and how their work connects to the buyers in Jarod's ledger. Bring the document back to Dezco.
quests.completion: The cuts match Jarod's ledger. Someone is buying relics that should have stayed buried.
quests.request_text: Bring fresh orders, inspect the apparatus, then we can compare the buyer's mark.
quests.return_text: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco at the Dawnchaser field camp.

quests.title: The Pools of Youth
quests.objectives: Speak to Na Lek, defeat four bound pool guardians, and bring the purified water to Kang.
quests.description: Na Lek is held near the ward-tainted pool. Speak to the water spirit and help break the guardians' hold. He will aid you while you fight four bound guardians, then allow a purified sample to be drawn. The defeated guardians remain recorded if the encounter is interrupted; return to Na Lek to resume or recover a sample that would not fit in your bags.
quests.completion: This water drains life. I will not give it to Leza as medicine. I can explain the mark, but I cannot undo what she has already suffered.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Kang Bramblestaff at the Dawnchaser cooking hearth.

quests.title: Life
quests.objectives: Stay near the medical tent through Leza's delivery and Nala's care for the family.
quests.description: Speak to Nala at the field hospital to begin Leza's delivery scene. Stay nearby while the family and healer work. The tent is shelter, not a scene button. Redhorn and Cloudhoof must both be safe when the scene ends.
quests.completion: Leza is gone. Redhorn and Cloudhoof are here. I must be here for them, too.
quests.request_text: Stay with Nala through the delivery. I will be beside Leza.
quests.return_text: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco at the Dawnchaser field camp.

quests.title: A Quiet Vigil
quests.objectives: Attend the memorial and accept Leza's keepsake without a combat objective.
quests.description: Speak to Dezco, then join him at Leza's memorial for a quiet vigil. Remain nearby until he has finished. The fire is a memorial, not a control to click.
quests.completion: Keep this totem. Let it remind you that the person who dies is more than the moment of their death.
quests.request_text: Have you spent a little time at Leza's memorial?
quests.return_text: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco at the Dawnchaser field camp.

quests.title: For the Living
quests.objectives: Deliver food to 3 refugee groups and speak with Dezco about his sons and remaining expedition.
quests.description: Redhorn and Cloudhoof breathe, and others still need to eat. Take these three food bundles to the Dawnchaser families, displaced travelers and expedition wounded. Give each group one bundle, then speak with me about the boys and the people who remain. We will carry our grief; we will not leave the living behind.
quests.completion: We will move when the children and the wounded can move. The expedition still has a purpose.
quests.request_text: Each group needs one bundle. When all three have eaten, we can speak about the journey ahead.
quests.return_text: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco at the Dawnchaser field camp.

quests.title: Leave a Place Better
quests.objectives: Deliver the village introduction letter to Mei at the affected settlement.
quests.description: The people at the wayside settlement southwest of here have been facing the same raiders, and hope is wearing thin there. Take my introduction to Mei Barrelbottom at the relief station on the Mudsprocket road. Tell her what our camp has learned and what you are willing to do.
quests.completion: Kang speaks well of you. There is work to do here, and people who have forgotten that help can arrive.
quests.return_text: Speak with Mei Barrelbottom at the relief station on the Mudsprocket road.

TEXT_NALA_TWINS.text: Redhorn and Cloudhoof are resting. Both boys are strong, and I will stay beside them. When you are ready, I can show you how they are doing.
